Implement the scoped Beacon feature.
Feature: markdown-first-freeze-truth-and-minimal-machine-state-contract
Version: v1.4.8
Read Beacon source of truth:
- docs/beacon/v1.4.8/user-story/markdown-first-freeze-truth-and-minimal-machine-state-contract.md
- docs/beacon/v1.4.8/prd/markdown-first-freeze-truth-and-minimal-machine-state-contract.md
- docs/beacon/v1.4.8/qa/test-cases/markdown-first-freeze-truth-and-minimal-machine-state-contract.md
- docs/beacon/v1.4.8/.machine/execution/implementation-plan-markdown-first-freeze-truth-and-minimal-machine-state-contract.json
Reuse Beacon semantic layer:
- docs/beacon/v1.4.8/.machine/trace/semantic/markdown-first-freeze-truth-and-minimal-machine-state-contract/semantic-contract.json
- docs/beacon/v1.4.8/.machine/trace/semantic/markdown-first-freeze-truth-and-minimal-machine-state-contract/semantic-dictionary.md
- docs/beacon/v1.4.8/.machine/trace/semantic/markdown-first-freeze-truth-and-minimal-machine-state-contract/semantic-usage-guidelines.md
Default design bridge (augmentation only): taste-skill @ https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill
Follow Beacon boundary defaults:
- Record explicit assumptions and ambiguity tradeoffs instead of silently picking one interpretation.
- Prefer the smallest correct change; avoid speculative abstraction or future-facing config unless required.
- Keep changes surgical; only touch files in the current scope and only clean up orphan artifacts you introduce.
- Bind work to verification signals; include acceptance/test mapping or concrete evidence for non-trivial tasks.
- For obvious typo or single-line copy fixes, stay lightweight but do not expand scope or touch unrelated files.
Implement only against the frozen PRD, user-story, and test-case truth above.
Do not invent new user stories, acceptance criteria, or test scope.
If the work would require requirement change or conflicts with frozen truth, stop and route to beacon-change/refreeze instead of coding around it.
Structured result should include: assumptions, simplicity_notes, scope_guard, verification.
For changed revisions with cleanup obligation, structured result must also include: cleanup_review_completed, removed_surfaces, retained_legacy_surfaces, cleanup_rationale.
Run relevant verification.
Write structured result to .beacon/implement/run-20260521T115111Z-408c/result.json
